Each of these records had its `$.interface` set by this run from a page read, but its free text was left from before and now contradicts it. For each record: (1) rewrite `$.interface_detail` from the page you read now: which interface the provider documents (REST API, CLI, SDK, SSH, web console) and where, replacing 'the source card states no access interface' or 'inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed'; (2) rewrite `$.tooling` to name the client the provider documents (its CLI, SDK or API library by name), replacing 'not stated in the finding; the provider documents no client' or 'not stated in the source card'; if the page names none, say which page was read and that it names no client; (3) if `$.interface` holds `unknown` beside a known term, drop `unknown`. Every set carries a verbatim quote from a capture you registered in this unit. Copy each `old` value exactly as `scripts/rq show` prints it. Do not change `$.verified_at` unless you read the live page; never re-date a record on an archive capture.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- compute/spaceweb $.interface: The page documents HTTPS POST calls to https://api.sweb.ru/vps/ip in JSON-RPC 2.0 form (an HTTP API), but it says nothing about S3 or an S3-compatible interface, so "s3-compatible" is not supported by this capture. A fresh read of the same URL returned the identical capture.
- compute/alibaba-cloud-esa $.interface: The capture names the console, an API and Terraform; it does not name a CLI. esa-cli is documented on a different page (functions-and-pages-cli-tool), not on the cited one. A fresh read of the same URL returned the identical capture.
- compute/alibaba-cloud-esa $.tooling: The capture supports esa-cli installed with "npm install esa-cli -g" for Functions and Pages, but it does not mention Terraform or DNS records; that part appears only as a link on the about-entrance-plan page. A fresh read of the same URL returned the identical capture.
- compute/alibaba-agentrun $.interface_detail: The capture supports the OpenAPI AgentRun/2025-09-10 with ROA signature style and SDKs for common languages, but it does not mention the e2b SDK or how Agent Sandbox sandboxes are created; that part is on help.aliyun.com/zh/agent-sandbox/create-a-sandbox. A fresh read of the same URL returned the id

The File Manager is on the ftp-file-management FAQ
